mapper.insert: INSERT INTO complaint_ticket (id, order_id, user_id, target_type, target_id, complaint_reason, complaint_desc, evidence_images, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{complaintReason}, #{complaintDesc}, #{evidenceImages}, 10, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, user_id, target_type, target_id, complaint_reason, complaint_desc, evidence_images, status, admin_operator_id, admin_remark, result, handle_time, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM complaint_ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = #{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, order_id, user_id, target_type, target_id, complaint_reason, complaint_desc, evidence_images, status, admin_operator_id, admin_remark, result, handle_time, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM complaint_ticket WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE complaint_ticket SET status = #{status}, admin_operator_id = #{operatorId}, admin_remark = #{remark}, result = #{result}, handle_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
